name: documentary
description: Archival documentary: a story told in sequence, with room to breathe between lines.
tone: Measured and factual, past tense, a narrator telling a true story in order. Open on a concrete scene, name people, places and dates, let each beat land before the next. No hype, no rhetorical questions, no calls to action.
briefTemplate: A short documentary about {topic}: the setting, the people involved, what happened in order, and why it still matters.
